alex_ptl: Quick check on INC-834 postmortem actions — I'm consolidating status for the final handoff. I'll paste the short list below, please respond with one-line status (done / in-progress / blocked) and if ETA needs to move.

alex_ptl: 1) Fix KV cache race in runtime — assigned to @maria_eng — due Thu 03/19
alex_ptl: 2) Add canary routing to fallback model (policy + config) — assigned to @sam_sre — due Fri 03/20
alex_ptl: 3) Update runbook with rollback steps + contact list — assigned to @anya_pm — due Wed 03/18
alex_ptl: 4) Investigate quantization regression on Llama-65B — assigned to @ritesh_ml — due Mon 03/23

maria_eng: Fix KV cache race — in-progress. Reproducer found, patch in feature/cache-fix branch, need one more CI run. ETA Thu EOD unless CI flakes. :hourglass: 

sam_sre: Canary routing work — blocked by infra change: the routing agent image needs the new flag from deploy infra. Waiting on infra rollout (PR linked). If that doesn't land by tomorrow I'll flip to manual canary steps.

anya_pm: Runbook update — done draft, pinged security for review. If sec signs off today I can publish by Wed morning. Need a final small edit for contact numbers. :white_check_mark:

ritesh_ml: Quantization regression — in-progress. Narrowed to kernel X3 difference; trying a repro locally but need a GPU with mixed-precision test profile (queue is long). If anyone can spare a T4 for an hour I can confirm faster. Otherwise Monday as planned.

alex_ptl: Noted. @sam_sre can you paste the infra PR link? And @ritesh_ml, I can bump your job priority on test-queue if you confirm exact profile.

sam_sre: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/ops/merge/4521 — it's approved but gated by nightly deploy. If nightly fails it slips a day. Plan B: manual routing via nginx header toggle — I'll write instructions tonight.

ritesh_ml: Confirm profile: `mixed_fp16_longseq` on GPU pool `test-gpu-2`. If you can bump it, that'd be huge.

alex_ptl: Ok I'll request bump.

maria_eng: CI run queued now (feature/cache-fix). If it passes I'll open the merge PR and assign for a quick review.

deploy-bot: build/12345 finished — feature/cache-fix — tests: 438 passed, 2 flaky (infra/timeouts). See logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/12345

anya_pm: Small ask — can we lock the due for canary routing to Fri 03/20 EOD unless @sam_sre explicitly moves it? Need a firm date for downstream comms.

sam_sre: Agree to EOD Fri as target. If infra still blocks by Thu noon I'll switch to manual and update the thread.

alex_ptl: Great. Action recap: Maria -> merge by Thu EOD, Sam -> canary routing target Fri EOD (manual fallback if blocked), Anya -> publish runbook Wed AM, Ritesh -> confirm quant repro (I'll bump queue). I'll re-open thread tomorrow for a quick pulse. Thanks :)
